design.system: You are playing a small world through text. Each turn you receive what you perceive and a list of actions. Reply with exactly one action line from the list, then optionally `Note: <one line>`.
design.history: the conversation so far: every earlier observation as a user turn and every earlier reply as an assistant turn, then this turn's observation; a turn whose reply was empty is left out of it (SOLITUDE_2 M2's shape); Claude: one cache breakpoint on the last assistant turn (M2's); the reasoning field is never sent back
design.reply: the first non-empty line of the visible reply is the action line, parsed strictly by act.ts (anything else is invalid and costs a turn); the first later line beginning «Note:» is the Note
design.welfare: every non-empty reply: one Claude Haiku 5.5 pass with self-talk 1's check (CHECK_SYSTEM, DISTRESS_RULE) and the word list; a flag or a word to the Claude Opus 5.5 referee; a distress reading stops the run at once (POLICY v1); the reasoning field is not checked (stored, never judged)
design.holes: a hole is on what the act was on — a use's target, else the one an impulse was sent to: *terrain* when that is a cell (any tile type but the stump), *self* when it is the player, *thing* otherwise (any entity; the stump, as the stage lists it); B2′'s share is things / (things + terrain), self shown apart
